name: Question 1
worked_solution:
First, we pull out the factor of $3$ from the denominator:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{0}\frac{2x+5}{3x-1}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{-1}^{0}\frac{2x+5}{3(x-\frac{1}{3})}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{-1}^{0}\frac{2x+5}{(x-\frac{1}{3})}\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we draw up our synthetic division table to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder.

$$
\begin{aligned} & x & {x}^{0} \\ \frac{1}{3} & 2 & 5 \\  & ↓ & \frac{2}{3} \\  & 2 & \frac{17}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

So from the synthetic division, we get that

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2x+5}{(x-\frac{1}{3})} & =2+\frac{(\frac{17}{3})}{(x-\frac{1}{3})} \\  & =2+\frac{17}{3(x-\frac{1}{3})} \\  & =2+\frac{17}{3x-1}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{0}\frac{2x+5}{3x-1}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{1}{3}{\int }_{-1}^{0}(2+\frac{17}{3x-1})\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[2{\int }_{-1}^{0}\text{d}x+17{\int }_{-1}^{0}\frac{1}{3x-1}\,\text{d}x] \\  & =\frac{1}{3}{[2x+\frac{17}{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡|3x-1|]}_{-1}^{0} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[2(0-(-1))+\frac{17}{3}(\operatorname{ln}⁡|3(0)-1|-\operatorname{ln}⁡|3(-1)-1|)] \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[2(1)+\frac{17}{3}(\operatorname{ln}⁡1-\operatorname{ln}⁡4)] \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[2-\frac{17}{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡({2}^{2})] \\  & =\frac{1}{3}[2-\frac{34}{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡2] \\  & =\frac{2}{9}[3-17\operatorname{ln}⁡2].\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

First, we pull out the factor of 3 from the denominator: ∫−102x+53x−1dx=∫−102x+53(x−13)dx=13∫−102x+5(x−13)dx.

Then, we draw up our synthetic division table to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder. xx01325↓232173

So from the synthetic division, we get that 2x+5(x−13)=2+(173)(x−13)=2+173(x−13)=2+173x−1.

Therefore, ∫−102x+53x−1dx=13∫−10(2+173x−1)dx=13[2∫−10dx+17∫−1013x−1dx]=13[2x+173ln⁡|3x−1|]−10=13[2(0−(−1))+173(ln⁡|3(0)−1|−ln⁡|3(−1)−1|)]=13[2(1)+173(ln⁡1−ln⁡4)]=13[2−173ln⁡(22)]=13[2−343ln⁡2]=29[3−17ln⁡2].
